_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Môko Sèpè so {width}×{height} kété.
Mo kontrol sèpè {player_id}. Môko ti gbé '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (oua w/s/a/d).
Gbôngô: môko ti môko ngbè tî so gbéa oua môko ti zo gbéa môko sô (kété {max_turns} môko).

board.after_moves: Ndokua ti batango azo so ayeke na yâ ni laso: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Ngbo {player_id} akui ndali ti so a gue na lo nzoni pëpe.

outcome.survived_win: Zo ti pikango ye {player_id} asö kuâ; tanga ni kue akui.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Köli ngbânga zîa tî ndö gbâ tî ènzî.
outcome.outlived: Zo ti pikango ndembo ni angbâ na fini ahon tanga ti azo kue.
outcome.turn_limit: A si na katikati ti tour ni awe - zo so ayeke wara ye mingi ahon atanga ni kue awara fini.
